_doc: Per-game enemy variant vocabulary (Phase 3b). A placement opts in via {"variant": "<name>"} in its overrides; the definition stays canonical. stat_mults multiply definition stats; behavior overrides behavior params; visual tells review surfaces how to mark it (outline / scale / outline_scale). Per-level caps live in game_rules.json variant_caps. Copy this file to make a different game and point the runner at it with --variants.
